source: 30. Design a production ZXNAME0000XZ system for a changing enterprise corpus with permissions, citations, multi-hop questions, long documents, and a strict latency ZXNAME0001XZ. How would you prove each layer works? [Advanced - System Design] Start with governance and workload, not a vector database. Ingestion should preserve source IDs, versions, structure, and ACLs; parsing must be tested on representative PDFs/tables. Build a simple lexical+dense baseline, measure evidence recall, then add reranking only if it improves the candidate-to-context step. Choose chunking from document structure and evaluation rather than a fixed token recipe; use hierarchical or contextualized retrieval only for failure cases they solve. Apply authorization before prompt assembly. For multi-hop questions, route to iterative retrieval; for corpus-level thematic questions, consider graph/hierarchical methods; for small bounded corpora, test long-context directly. Context packing should deduplicate, preserve provenance, order high-value evidence deliberately, and fit an explicit token budget. The generator should cite source spans and abstain when evidence is insufficient or conflicting. Security tests must include poisoned/instruction-bearing documents and permission boundaries. Prove the system with layer-specific evals plus end-to-end slices, latency/cost SLOs, freshness lag, and incident logging. Every added component needs a measured failure mode it fixes; otherwise it is architectural decoration. [3][25][26][27][30]
zh: 30. 为不断变化的企业语料库设计一个生产 ZXNAME0000XZ 系统，具有权限、引用、多跳问题、长文档和严格的延迟 ZXNAME0001XZ。你如何证明每一层都有效？ [高级-系统设计] 从治理和工作负载开始，而不是矢量数据库。摄取应保留源 ID、版本、结构和 ACL；解析必须在有代表性的 PDF/表格上进行测试。构建一个简单的词汇+密集基线，测量证据回忆，然后仅在改进候选到上下文步骤时添加重新排名。从文档结构和评估中选择分块，而不是固定的标记配方；仅对他们解决的失败案例使用分层或上下文检索。在快速组装之前申请授权。对于多跳问题，路由至迭代检索；对于语料库级别的主题问题，考虑图表/分层方法；对于小型有界语料库，直接测试长上下文。上下文打包应该消除重复、保留来源、有意订购高价值证据，并符合明确的代币预算。生成者应引用来源范围，并在证据不足或相互矛盾时放弃。安全测试必须包括中毒/带有指令的文档和权限边界。通过特定于层的评估以及端到端切片、延迟/成本 SLO、新鲜度滞后和事件记录来证明系统。每个添加的组件都需要一个可测量的故障模式来修复；否则就是建筑装饰。 [3][25][26][27][30]
